fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 is the only selectable route, and only after mutation. Its claimed all-a lifting does not follow from scale-equivariance plus Z-saturation: the proposed state may forget internal kernels, higher P-adic terms, and signed histories that later reappear, while fixing one legal input omits values, orientations, DROP, and deeper sibling states.

The N=8 NAND survivor currently certifies only depth-one energy. No quaternionic NAND lift with Q1 grade-zero exclusion, no COPY tile, and no depth-two transfer certificate exists, so none may be assumed when constructing the transducer.

Proposal 2's displayed colon inclusion is not shown equivalent to Q2. Q2 concerns affine adverse boundary classes and one-step filtered transfer under gluing, whereas a module colon condition can omit boundary labels, DROP, energy, and hidden signed fibers; SNF identities prove nothing until that equivalence is formalized.

Proposal 3 has no confinement theorem. Pairwise noncancellation of two distinct F17-lines does not cover sums of three or more signed terms, and a SAT line coloring neither realizes saturated integral tiles nor prevents unrestricted glued fibers from spanning all of F289.

Proposal 4 changes the construction without supplying NAND/COPY tiles or completeness accounting. A depth-four search over O/P^4 cannot establish an all-depth column-distance recurrence, and restricting to monomial matrices and diagonal shifts does not cover the generic signed-splice and cancellation attacks.

Proposal 5 misidentifies the obstruction: lifting one adverse element is not equivalent to splitting a short exact sequence, and circuit pushout/gluing is not automatically Yoneda multiplication. Nonvanishing of an Ext power would also not by itself imply one P-adic valuation gain or a Euclidean norm bound.

Proposal 6 assumes the finite sufficient-state automaton that Proposal 1 still must prove. Avoiding selected cycle minors over F289 does not establish that all bad cycles were represented, and Hensel lifting does not automatically preserve integral saturation, exact completeness energy, or exclusion of torsion at other primes.
evidence: The supplied Q12 verifier found a genuine depth-one NAND survivor with legal energy 8 and false energies 160,64,56,56, but explicitly established neither COPY nor recursive filtration. This supports exactly a bounded composition audit, not an asymptotic claim.
The canonical F289 experiment produced grade-zero signed pseudosections of energy 16, showing that residue and skew-graded language alone does not enforce adverse injectivity.

G5 found short kernel moves in every tested overlap, while G19 and Goal G1 found exact signed and diagonal splices surviving extensive linear coherence rows. Thus local saturation or a compressed boundary state cannot be presumed compositional.

G28 had adverse growth below legal growth, and G32/G37 exhibited exact additive parity across copies. These results require explicit unrestricted legal-versus-adverse transfer tables rather than promotion of a finite local pass.

ROADMAP.md identifies the current frontier as Q2 together with missing COPY in Q1 and prescribes exhaustive COPY plus NAND–COPY grade-zero/grade-one testing. STATUS.md confirms that no hardness lemma or dimension-dependent gap exists.
